tools.name: list_public_ladders
tools.description: Public ladders on Club Ladder: ladders whose organizers made them public, with name, id, player count and link. Use to find a club's ladder by name before reading its standings. Private ladders and ladders shared only by link are never listed.

tools.name: get_public_ladder
tools.description: Standings of one public ladder, by id or ladder link: each named player's Lichess and chess.com rating, change and games in one time control, sorted as on the ladder page, plus this week's awards and recent results. Comes in pages; use offset for the next page. Private and link-only ladders are neve

tools.name: estimate_rating
tools.description: Converts one rating between Lichess and chess.com for a time control, from people who play on both sites. Give lichess or chesscom (exactly one) and time_control. Returns the estimate on the other site and the range most people with that rating fall in.

tools.name: rating_percentile
tools.description: Where one Lichess or chess.com rating sits among the club players, team members and people on both sites whose settled ratings Club Ladder reads: the share below it and the percentiles of that pool. tools.name: find_lichess_clubs
tools.description: Up to ten Lichess clubs (teams) where the given rating sits in the middle half of the members' blitz or rapid ratings, largest first, with member counts, medians, how many members were active in the last month, and a Start link for each. Use when a player wants a club at their level.
